  warning: false
---

```{r}
#| label: parameters
# Parameters -------------------------------------------------------------------
SUMMARY_DIR <- Sys.getenv("REDESIGN_SUMMARY_DIR", "runs/2026-11-02_redesign-summary") # 08_summarise-benchmark.R tables, relative to the repo root
DECISION_DIR <- Sys.getenv("REDESIGN_DECISION_DIR", "") # 11_apply-decision-rule.R output; empty to skip the decision section
COVERAGE_TARGET <- 0.9 # nominal level of the credible interval
COVERAGE_BAND <- c(0.85, 0.97) # pass band of the decision rule (plan, rule 1)
FALSE_SIGN_MAX <- 0.07 # pass limit of the decision rule (plan, rule 1)
CAL_SCORES <- c("RMS", "CPS", "CCS") # scores of the decision rule
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(forcats)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
})
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 8))
read_run <- \(f) read_tsv(file.path(here::here(SUMMARY_DIR), f), show_col_types = FALSE)
roles <- read_run("scenario_roles.tsv")
scenario_levels <- roles |> filter(role == "main") |> pull(scenario_id)
# One palette keyed by method label; an unknown label fails. Reference methods are grey-blue / green.
METHOD_COLOURS <- c(
  C0 = "#999999",
  C1 = "#D55E00",
  C2 = "#CC79A7",
  C2phi = "#E69F00",
  COMPASS_default = "#0072B2",
  COMPASS_nofilter = "#56B4E9",
  polyICSFlow_clipped = "#009E73",
  polyICSFlow_unclipped = "#BBBBBB"
)
as_method <- \(x) {
  stopifnot("unknown method label" = all(x %in% names(METHOD_COLOURS)))
  fct(x, levels = names(METHOD_COLOURS))
}
tidy_scenario <- \(d) mutate(d, scenario_id = fct(scenario_id, levels = scenario_levels), model = as_method(model))
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)
```

## Completion

Every scenario and seed that finished is counted; a model that the package could not fit is `not_run` and has no points.

```{r}
read_run("model_status.tsv") |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Coverage

Each point is one replicate (24 donors, or the 100-donor cell excluded here); the bar is the mean over seeds with the seed-clustered SE; the dotted lines are the pass band. Rows are the truth the interval is scored against: the realised sample probability (the `cj_draws` estimand) and the structured mean.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7
cov_points <- read_run("calibration_replicate.tsv") |>
  filter(draws == "sample", grain == "global", score %in% CAL_SCORES, scenario_id %in% scenario_levels) |>
  tidy_scenario()
cov_summary <- read_run("calibration.tsv") |>
  filter(draws == "sample", grain == "global", score %in% CAL_SCORES, scenario_id %in% scenario_levels) |>
  tidy_scenario()
ggplot(cov_summary, aes(scenario_id, coverage, colour = model)) +
  geom_point(
    data = cov_points,
    aes(y = coverage),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.7, seed = 1),
    size = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(ymin = coverage - coverage_se, ymax = coverage + coverage_se),
    position = dodge,
    size = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(COVERAGE_BAND, COVERAGE_TARGET), linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = METHOD_COLOURS, drop = TRUE) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(target, score)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Coverage of the 90% interval (donors x contrasts per seed)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

### Structured draws against the structured truth

The overdispersed models also return the structured mean `mu` (draws = structured). Coverage of those draws against the structured truth, mean over scenarios; `n_scenarios` counts the scenarios averaged.

```{r}
read_run("calibration.tsv") |>
  filter(grain == "global", score %in% CAL_SCORES, scenario_id %in% scenario_levels) |>
  filter((draws == "structured" & target == "struct") | (draws == "sample" & target == "struct")) |>
  summarise(coverage = mean(coverage), n_scenarios = n_distinct(scenario_id), .by = c(model, draws, score)) |>
  mutate(coverage = signif(coverage, 3)) |>
  arrange(score, model, draws) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## RMSE and interval width

RMSE is the root mean squared error of the donor-level score estimate, one point per replicate, with the pooled RMSE as a bar; the width ratio is the mean interval width relative to C0 in the same scenario and target.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
rmse_points <- cov_points |> mutate(rmse = sqrt(mse)) |> filter(score == "RMS")
rmse_summary <- cov_summary |> filter(score == "RMS")
ggplot(rmse_summary, aes(scenario_id, rmse, colour = model)) +
  geom_point(
    data = rmse_points,
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.7, seed = 1),
    size = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = rmse - rmse_se, ymax = rmse + rmse_se), position = dodge, size = 0.25) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = METHOD_COLOURS, drop = TRUE) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(target)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "RMSE of donor RMS (fraction of parent cells, log scale)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
ggplot(cov_summary |> filter(score %in% CAL_SCORES, model != "C0"), aes(scenario_id, width_ratio, colour = model)) +
  geom_point(position = dodge, size = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = METHOD_COLOURS, drop = TRUE) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(target, score)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Interval width relative to C0 (log scale)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## False signs

A false sign is a donor-contrast whose true score is exactly zero (null cells, mixture non-responders) while the model puts more than 95% probability on a nonzero change in either direction. Points are replicates; the bar is the mean with the seed-clustered SE; the dotted line is the decision limit.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
fs_points <- read_run("false_sign_replicate.tsv") |>
  filter(draws == "sample", grain == "global", score %in% CAL_SCORES) |>
  tidy_scenario()
fs_summary <- read_run("false_sign.tsv") |>
  filter(draws == "sample", grain == "global", score %in% CAL_SCORES) |>
  tidy_scenario()
ggplot(fs_summary, aes(scenario_id, false_sign, colour = model)) +
  geom_point(
    data = fs_points,
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.7, seed = 1),
    size = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = false_sign - false_sign_se, ymax = false_sign + false_sign_se), position = dodge, size = 0.25) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = FALSE_SIGN_MAX, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = METHOD_COLOURS, drop = TRUE) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(target, score)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "False sign rate (rows with zero truth)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## IPF failures

The share of posterior draws whose counterfactual (IPF) failed, per scenario and model; the rule requires less than 1%.

```{r}
read_run("ipf.tsv") |>
  filter(draws == "sample") |>
  mutate(ipf_failed_rate = signif(ipf_failed_rate, 3)) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = scenario_id, names_from = model, values_from = ipf_failed_rate) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Pattern-level coverage

Coverage of the exact-pattern contributions by pattern degree, against the realised sample truth; degree 3 and higher is the C3 trigger.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
pat_summary <- read_run("calibration.tsv") |>
  filter(draws == "sample", grain == "pattern", target == "sample", scenario_id %in% scenario_levels) |>
  tidy_scenario() |>
  mutate(degree = fct(as.character(degree)))
ggplot(pat_summary, aes(scenario_id, coverage, colour = model, shape = degree)) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(ymin = coverage - coverage_se, ymax = coverage + coverage_se),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = COVERAGE_TARGET, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = METHOD_COLOURS, drop = TRUE) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(score)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Pattern coverage (seed mean, SE bars)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Visit change

Coverage of the v1 to v2 change in the two-visit cell, per donor and for the equal-donor average.

```{r}
change <- read_run("change.tsv")
if (nrow(change) > 0) {
  change |>
    filter(score %in% c(CAL_SCORES, "marker_magnitude")) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) signif(x, 3))) |>
    knitr::kable()
}
```

## Detection AUC with COMPASS and polyICSFlow

Each point is the AUC of one replicate; the bar is the pooled AUC with the seed-bootstrap SE. Responders are those with true RMS above 1e-4 (the realised sample truth); COMPASS and polyICSFlow are the reference lines of the plan.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7
AUC_SCORES <- c("P_RMS_gt_eps", "Response", "net_sum") # one score per method; every score is in auc.tsv
tidy_detector <- \(d) {
  d |>
    separate_wider_delim(detector, " ", names = c("model", "score")) |>
    filter(score %in% AUC_SCORES, target == "sample") |>
    mutate(scenario_id = fct(scenario_id, levels = scenario_levels), model = as_method(model))
}
auc_summary <- read_run("auc.tsv") |> tidy_detector() |> filter(comparison == "vs_null", !is.na(scenario_id))
auc_points <- read_run("auc_replicate.tsv") |> tidy_detector() |> filter(comparison == "vs_null", !is.na(scenario_id))
ggplot(auc_summary, aes(scenario_id, auc, colour = model)) +
  geom_point(
    data = auc_points,
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.7, seed = 1),
    size = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = auc - se, ymax = auc + se), position = dodge, size = 0.25) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = METHOD_COLOURS, drop = TRUE) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "AUC, responders vs null donors") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Runtime

Seconds per replicate and method (fit plus scoring for the candidates; CPUs differ: 4 for the Stan fits, 1 for C0, COMPASS and polyICSFlow). The 100-donor cell is the runtime-only cell. Points are replicates; the bar is the median with the interquartile range.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
rt_points <- read_run("runtime_replicate.tsv") |> mutate(model = as_method(method))
rt_summary <- read_run("runtime.tsv") |> mutate(model = as_method(method))
ggplot(rt_summary, aes(scenario_id, median_s, colour = model)) +
  geom_point(
    data = rt_points,
    aes(y = seconds),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.7, seed = 1),
    size = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = q25_s, ymax = q75_s), position = dodge, size = 0.25) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = METHOD_COLOURS, drop = TRUE) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Seconds per replicate (log scale)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Convergence

Candidate fits that missed R-hat 1.01, bulk ESS 400 or had divergences, and the median phi of the overdispersed models.

```{r}
read_run("diagnostics.tsv") |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) signif(x, 3))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Decision

The decision rule of the plan, applied mechanically to the A/B/C summary before the held-out generator was opened.

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (nzchar(DECISION_DIR)) {
  cat(readLines(file.path(here::here(DECISION_DIR), "decision.md")), sep = "\n")
  read_tsv(file.path(here::here(DECISION_DIR), "decision.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) signif(x, 3))) |>
    knitr::kable() |>
    print()
}
```
